subject: Suggestion popup closes after partial input; no visual guidance or confirmation before auto-dismissal
description_raw: ### **Actual Behavior** After adding a new product, a dialog recommending 3 related products appeared (good feature). When I added the **title** and **price** for one of the suggested products, the **CTA (submit button)** became disabled without any message explaining what’s missing. Upon uploading an image, the entire dialog **closed automatically**, even though I was still in the middle of editing the suggested entries. ### **Expected Behavior** There should be a clear message indicating **why CTA is disabled** (e.g., “Please add image to continue”). The popup/dialog should **not close automatically** unless all mandatory product fields are filled and a final confirmation is given. If only partial data is entered for the suggested products, the system should ask: _“Do you want to save this product draft or discard it?”_ At the very least, there should be a **visual cue** indicating the action taken when the dialog closes. ### **Steps to reproduce:** Add a new product from the seller panel On the confirmation screen, notice the 3 recommended products Try to add title and price for any of the suggested products Observe: CTA gets disabled, no reason shown Try uploading an image Observe: The entire dialog closes without confirmation or warning ### **Test Environment:** ### **Logs:** Console Errors: Not available Backend: Possibly relevant for tracking why CTA is blocked Crash Report: No crash, but unexpected UI closure ### **User Type:** **Company**: Global Lift Private Limited (Test) **Group**: ExportTS **GL User ID**: 10359580 ### **Bug Type:** UX Functional ### **Bug Source:** User Journey Testing

subject: No Visual Cue for Minimum Character Requirement in Product Description Field

subject: Notification is not tracked when Auth Token is expired.
description_raw:
### **Actual Behavior**

AK is expired if user does not open the App in past 24 hours.  
Once the AK is expired, and a notification is received to an iOS device, Service extension is triggered but does not checks for error and fetchs new AK.  
Service extension triggers notifcation\_edit API with status as "1" with expired AK, resulting in Authentication failure error. This leads to a significant drop in notification delivered count Startting from app version 13.4.6.

### **Expected Behavior**

Notification should be tracked with updated AK without still waking up the app in the background.

subject: Payload Validation in Suggestive Replies API – Type Mismatches & Extra Params
description_raw:
Hi  Team,

We’ve observed inconsistencies in the request payload being sent to the **Suggestive Replies** API. Specifically:

Some fields like loggedin\_glid  and contact\_user\_glid are sometimes sent as int instead of the expected string.

Extra/unnecessary parameters are also being sent in certain cases, which are not part of the accepted schema.

To ensure **security, consistency, and reliability**, we are now enforcing strict payload validation. **Only the following parameters with the specified types will be accepted going forward:**

```text
{
  "contact_user_glid":      string,
  "loggedin_glid":          string,
  "modid":                  string,
  "AK":                     string,
  "app_version_no":         string,
  "MODID":                  string,
  "magicpen":               int,
  "is_whatsapp_enabled":    int,
  "price_per_unit":         string,
  "price_unit":             string,
  "min_qty":                string
}
```

**Action Required**:

Cross-check all touchpoints (web, app, LMS, etc.). where suggestive replies is getting called.

Ensure only a set of above keys are passed.

Ensure the type of each value matches the defined type.

Remove any additional parameters being sent.

Please correct this on priority to prevent disruptions in Suggestive Replies API. As going forward the payload which won't match the given schema will be dropped.

subject: Unexpected Catalog View Purchase Tracking in BL Search from ANDWEB Modid
description_raw:
Hi Team,

We have observed an inconsistency in the **catalog view purchase tracking for the BL Search journey** from the **ANDWEB modid**.

The catalog view changes for BL Search were made live on **May 23, 2025**. However, we are seeing `catalog view purchase` events being tracked as early as **May 1, 2025**, which is before the release date.

Below is the condition used to filter these events:

`AND ETO_LEAD_PUR_TYPE = 'C' AND LOWER(eto_lead_pur_position_url) LIKE '%search%'` 

This suggests that the event might have been getting tracked incorrectly or prematurely.

subject: Syncing Ask for Review Content
description_raw:
From Android, two types of 'Ask for review' have been sent.

1.  From Suggestive reply, where the text is: _We hope you had an amazing experience with us. Don't forget to provide a quick review._
2.  From three dot menu, where the text is: _We hope you had an amazing experience with us. Don't forget to leave a review._

On Desktop, there is a text-based check on 'Review Now' CTA and 'Share on WhatsApp' CTA, which we made after the AFR message. Since, for AFR sent through three dot menu, the text is different, these CTAs didn't show on the desktop.

So, sync the text of this AFR with the text of the 'Ask for review' getting from the suggestive reply API.

subject: Wrong MCAT displayed on the BuyLead Card on App

subject: WhatsApp Outbound Template - Content Mismatch Due to Trimming Issue
description_raw:
Hi Team,

We are encountering an error while sending the WhatsApp outbound template, as the content does not match the expected format. The issue appears to be related to the trimming of placeholder parameters.

For some sellers, the rating is not available, and in such cases, we are passing a blank space (`" "`) as the parameter for that placeholder. However, this is leading to a mismatch between the content shared by the Suggesting API and the one sent by the frontend via the Reply API.

**Example content from the givesuggestive API (with space):**

"Hi Sunil,

We have received your IndiaMART enquiry.

Do you need Leading Suppliers HVAC Contractors?

Catalog link: [https://www.cleanairahu.in/](https://www.cleanairahu.in/)

Company details:  
Caepl Clean Air Engineers Private Limited (Ahmedabad)  
GST Verified✅ | TrustSEAL Verified✅  "

**Example content from Frontend to Reply API (without space):**

"Hi Sunil,

We have received your IndiaMART enquiry.

Do you need Leading Suppliers HVAC Contractors?

Catalog link: [https://www.cleanairahu.in/](https://www.cleanairahu.in/)

Company details:  
Caepl Clean Air Engineers Private Limited (Ahmedabad)  
GST Verified✅ | TrustSEAL Verified✅"

This mismatch is triggering a template validation error from WhatsApp due to formatting differences, even though both contents appear identical. Please investigate the trimming or formatting discrepancies, especially when placeholder values are blank or set to a space.

**MOD ID:** ANDROID  
**fk\_rfq\_source\_id:** 468

subject: Wrong MCAT displayed on the BuyLead Card on App
description_raw: ### **Actual Behavior** The MCAT that is getting displayed on the BuyLead Card is different on desktop and app **Desktop Screenshot:** The category shown here is GI Modular Box **Android Screenshot:** The Category shown here is Concealed Metal Boxes  **Offer Details:** Offer Id: 122582461359 This offer is mapped under two categories, Concealed Metal Boxes (Prime), GI Modular Box (Secondary) Since the match making was done based on the secondary MCAT, the correct category to be displayed on the BL Card was GI Modular Box (as on desktop) On Android (both native and webview), we are reading the key PRIME\_MCAT\_NAME to display the category on the BL Card, which is returning the primary MCAT that the offer is mapped under **Expected Behavior** We need to display the correct category on the BL Card We need to read the category from the correct key to display on the BL Card

subject: Unable to display or add State and Country in "Do Not Prefer BuyLeads from these locations" section

**Actual Behavior:**  
In the "BuyLead Preference" screen, the "Do not prefer BuyLeads from these locations" section only displays cities. States and countries added as non-preferred locations are not shown.

**Expected Behavior:**  
The "Do not prefer BuyLeads from these locations" section should support and correctly display all types of locations — cities, states, and countries. Users should also be able to add states (in addition to cities) to the non-preferred location list using the UI.

**Steps to Reproduce:**

1.  Go to the **BuyLead Preference** page.
2.  Scroll to the **"Do not prefer BuyLeads from these locations"** section.
3.  Try adding a **state (Rajasthan)** as a non-preferred location.
4.  Observe that: States cannot be added.
5.  Even if present in the backend data, states and countries are not shown in the UI.

subject: Payload Validation in Suggestive Replies API – Type Mismatches & Extra Params
description_raw:
Hi  Team,

We’ve observed inconsistencies in the request payload being sent to the **Suggestive Replies**API. Specifically:

Some fields like loggedin\_glid  and contact\_user\_glid are sometimes sent as int instead of the expected string.

Extra/unnecessary parameters are also being sent in certain cases, which are not part of the accepted schema.

To ensure **security, consistency, and reliability**, we are now enforcing strict payload validation. **Only the following parameters with the specified types will be accepted going forward:**

{  

"contact\_user\_glid":      string,   

"loggedin\_glid":          string,  

"modid":                  string,  

"AK":                     string,  

"app\_version\_no":         string,  

"MODID":                  string,  

"magicpen":               int,

  "is\_whatsapp\_enabled":    int,

  "price\_per\_unit":         string,  

"price\_unit":             string,

  "min\_qty":                string

}

**Action Required**:

Cross-check all touchpoints (web, app, LMS, etc.). where suggestive replies is getting called.

Ensure only a set of above keys are passed.

Ensure the type of each value matches the defined type.

Remove any additional parameters being sent.

Please correct this on priority to prevent disruptions in Suggestive Replies API. As going forward the payload which won't match the given schema will be dropped.

Incident ticket for the same:  
https://project.intermesh.net/projects/android/work\_packages/592382

subject: Incorrect tracking params for android webview
description_raw: Hi team,  we are seeing a drop in txn and users count from BL-alerting mails which is aligning with scaling dates of Android webview. 20% scaling was done on 13th and 50% was done on 19th, we are not seeing any dip in transaction or users in Desktop, rather we are only seeing a dip in Mobile users. During testing as well, we found that for Primary and secondary txns, tracking is being wrongly attributed to eto\_lead\_fk\_gl\_module\_id = ANDWEB and eto\_lead\_pur\_mode = APP, the correct tracking should be ETO\_LEAD\_PUR\_MODE = 'MAILMOB' and ETO\_LEAD\_FK\_GL\_MODULE\_ID not IN ('ANDROID','ANDWEB','MY','HELLOTD','IMOB') (it should be AUTOINST or EMORNING or FMORNING or MORNING or WITHINST) (when transaction is being done directly from alert mail)

subject: MCAT mapping is not changing on product name change: item id: 300362222
description_raw: ### **Actual Behavior** MCAT mapping is not changing on product name change. ### **Expected Behavior** MCAT should change on product name change. ### **Steps to reproduce:** # Item Id : 300362222 **On 26 MAY 2025, 06:29:30 AM, User changed product name** **Changes done by:** User **Changes done using:** 'Android' (Edit - Edit Product Edit CTA Click) Old Product name: BiLevel/Bipap/Silicone Double Layer Old Mapped MCAT: BiPAP Machine (146972) Old MCAT position: 1 Old MCAT confidence w.r.t. product name: High New Product name: BiLevel/Bipap/Silicone Double Layer Mask New Mapped MCAT: Same as Old \[BiPAP Machine (146972)\]  However, New suggested MCAT by MCAT Search API: BiPAP Mask (178183) MCAT position: 1 MCAT confidence w.r.t. product name: High  Since the product name is changed, MCAT Search API’s response wrt new product name should be mapped. MCAT Search API was called and yet the mapping was not changed by User and old mapping got retained. We are not sure if this selection was deliberately made by user or old mapping got retained by default.  **pls check this case and let us know how to track if the selection is made by user or by default.** Here are the logs for both MCAT Search and SOA:  MCAT log: [https://imkibanaindia.intermesh.net/app/r/s/bz4N6](https://imkibanaindia.intermesh.net/app/r/s/bz4N6) Rank 1 Suggested MCAT details from MCAT log: MCAT1\_ID 178183   |   MCAT1\_NAME BiPAP Mask   |   MCAT1\_ACC High SOA log: [https://imkibanaindia.intermesh.net/app/r/s/9IDUg](https://imkibanaindia.intermesh.net/app/r/s/9IDUg) Selected MCAT detail from MCAT log: "new\_mcat\_mapping":"146972#-1\*1|"

subject: Latest BuyLeads Widget is showing old leads on Webview
description_raw:
### **Actual Behavior**

The “Latest BuyLeads” widget on the Seller Dashboard displays outdated leads  
This happens because the widget data is refreshed at fixed time intervals and not on every visit to the Seller Dashboard.   
As a result, sellers are seeing old leads, reducing trust and engagement with the widget  
  
This was working correctly on the native app earlier. The issue has surfaced after the transition to WebView, where the widget no longer refreshes with the latest data.

### **Expected Behavior**

The “Latest BuyLeads” widget should always reflect the most up-to-date leads for the seller.   
Specifically:  
1\. The widget should refresh data and timestamp whenever the seller visits the main BuyLeads page.  
2\. Leads displayed in the widget should be consistent with those on the BuyLeads page.  
3\. The “last updated” timestamp should reflect real-time updates.

subject: Wrong MCAT displayed on the BuyLead Card on App
description_raw: ### **Actual Behavior** The MCAT that is getting displayed on the BuyLead Card is different on desktop and app **Offer Details:** Offer Id: 122582461359 This offer is mapped under two categories, Concealed Metal Boxes (Prime), GI Modular Box (Secondary) Since the match making was done based on the secondary MCAT, the correct category to be displayed on the BL Card was GI Modular Box (as on desktop) On IOS, we are reading the key PRIME\_MCAT\_NAME to display the category on the BL Card, which is returning the primary MCAT that the offer is mapped under **Expected Behavior** We need to display the correct category on the BL Card We need to read the category from the correct key to display on the BL Card

subject: (Test server)Closing ratings popup on chat screen wrongly submits ratings when redirected via WhatsApp link
description_raw:
### **Actual Behavior**

When an Insta Seller shares a ratings link with a buyer via WhatsApp, the buyer is redirected to the IndiaMART iOS app chat screen where a ratings popup appears. If the buyer closes this popup using the cross icon instead of submitting it, the app incorrectly treats this action as a submission and displays the ratings in real time. However, when the user revisits the same chat screen from another page, the ratings do not appear.

### **Expected Behavior**

Closing the ratings popup by clicking the cross should dismiss the popup **without** submitting the ratings. Submission should only occur when the user taps on star or give the review and clicks on submit CTA.

### **Steps to reproduce:**

1.  Insta Seller shares a ratings link on WhatsApp
2.  Buyer clicks the link and is redirected to the chat screen in the IndiaMART iOS app
3.  Ratings popup appears
4.  Buyer closes the popup by clicking the cross 
5.  Observe that the ratings appear to be submitted on real time
6.  Navigate away and return to the same chat screen
7.  Ratings no longer display.

### **Test Environment**:

1.  **Device:** iphone13
2.  **Environment**: Stage
3.  **Operating System:** ios 18.5

subject: (Test server)Ratings link opens chat screen in wrong account when user not logged in with same account
description_raw:
### **Actual Behavior**

*   When an Insta Seller shares a ratings link via WhatsApp, if the buyer clicks the link while logged in with a **different account** (not the one that received the link), they are redirected to the chat screen of the logged-in account instead of being taken to the Buyer Dashboard. The ratings popup is displayed on this unrelated chat screen. If the buyer closes the popup using the cross (X) icon, the app wrongly submits the ratings in real time. However, when the user refreshes or revisits the chat screen, the ratings do not persist. 
*   Switch account functionality not working on bmc when user clicks on ratings link on Whatsapp

### **Expected Behavior**

*   If the buyer is not logged in with the same account that received the link, they should **not** land on the chat screen (BMC).
*   Instead, they should be redirected to the **Buyer Dashboard** of the logged-in account.
*   Closing the popup should **not** submit any ratings.
*   if buyer logged in and active with another account then account should be switch

### **Steps to reproduce:**

1.  Insta Seller shares a ratings link on WhatsApp
2.  Buyer opens the IndiaMART iOS app **logged in with a different account** than the one that received the link
3.  Buyer clicks the ratings link on whatsapp
4.  Buyer is redirected to the chat screen of the logged-in account with a ratings popup displayed
5.  Buyer closes the popup 
6.  Ratings get submitted in real time
7.  On refreshing or revisiting the same chat screen, the ratings are not displayed

### **Test Environment**:

1.  **Device:** iphone13
2.  **Environment**: Stage
3.  **Operating System:** ios 18.5

subject: Realm DB Crash
description_raw:
# Summary of the Crash

App fails on startup with the message:

> **“database has an unsupported version (9) and cannot be upgraded”**

## Why it happens

\-  Realm SDKs  **v10.49.0** and later **removed the internal logic** needed to open or migrate files created with the legacy file-format version **9**.  
\-  When your app tries to open a Realm file with \`Realm()\`, Realm Core **triggers a fatal error**—your migration block **never runs**, and the app crashes immediately.

## Simple Remedy

### 1\. Delete all Realm files that use the old version 9 format:

\-  \`<your-app>.realm\`  
\-  \`<your-app>.realm.lock\`  
\-  \`<your-app>.realm.note\`  
\-  \`<your-app>.realm.management\`

### 2\. On next launch

\-  Realm will \*\*create a fresh, empty database\*\* in the current format (version 10+), and your app will run normally.

## References & Further Reading

\-  \[MongoDB Dev Forum: "Could you please continue to support database version 9?"\](https://www.mongodb.com/community/forums/t/could-you-please-continue-to-support-database-version-9/274674)  
\-  \[GitHub Issue (realm-js): "Dropped support for database version 9"\](https://github.com/realm/realm-js/issues/6899)  
\-  \[Realm Swift API: Realm.deleteFiles(for:)\](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/realm-sdks/swift/latest/api/Classes/Realm.html#/s:10RealmSwift0A0C11deleteFiles4for6output8xpcErrorAC13ConfigurationV\_SbSgSo14NSErrorPointerCSgtKFZ)  
\-  \[Realm Migration Guide (Core 14+ upgrade path)\](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/realm/sync/upgrade-guides/core-14)

## Crash Link

[https://console.firebase.google.com/u/0/project/artful-affinity-634/crashlytics/app/ios:com.indiamart.m/issues/322a6b65ee51b012a457eea10ca68487?time=last-ninety-days&types=crash](https://console.firebase.google.com/u/0/project/artful-affinity-634/crashlytics/app/ios:com.indiamart.m/issues/322a6b65ee51b012a457eea10ca68487?time=last-ninety-days&types=crash)

subject: MCAT ID Not Consistently Passed to BL Transaction API from iOS App
description_raw:
**Actual Behaviour:**  
The iOS app does not consistently send the MCAT ID to the BL Transaction API when a user transacts on a Buylead.   
As a result, the MCAT ID is missing in several entries within the `eto_lead_pur_hist` and `iil_lead_pur_hist` tables.   
This inconsistency hinders accurate analysis of transaction patterns across MCAT categories.

**Expected Behaviour:**  
The iOS app should always pass the correct MCAT ID—corresponding to the matchmaking done with the seller—in every transaction sent to the BL Transaction API.

subject: Old OTP accepted & reused for multiple email verifications; new OTP not sent on retry
description_raw:
### **Actual Behavior**

Once an OTP is sent to a user’s email, if the user retries to verify the same email, a **new OTP is not received**.  
Additionally, the **old OTP (40–60 minutes old)** is still valid and allows successful verification. The same OTP can also be reused to verify **multiple secondary emails**, which is a security risk.

### **Expected Behavior**

OTP should **expire** after 5–10 minutes.

New OTP should be sent on each retry or resend request.

### **Steps to reproduce:**

1.  Login with free seller who has added email but not verified
2.  Click on seller tools
3.  A blocker pop-up comes to verify email
4.  Enter any old otp received 40-60 mins ago
5.  Otp is verified
6.  If user tries to add same email for any other account as secondary mail or without verifying again tries to add email with same steps
7.  New otp isn't received

### **Test Environment**:

1.  **Device:** Redmi note 9 pro max
2.  **Environment**: Stage
3.  **Operating System:** Android 12

subject: Rating pop-up not visible after 5 leads consumed
description_raw:
**Actual Behavior**

After consuming the 5th BuyLead, if the user consumes an additional lead via the Similar Leads screen, the rating pop-up does not appear upon closing the Similar Leads screen.

In cases where multiple accounts are logged into the same app instance, the rating pop-up appears only when 5 BuyLeads are consumed from a single account, rather than being triggered after 5 BuyLeads are consumed by any one of the logged-in accounts.

**Expected Behavior**

Once the 5th BuyLead is consumed, if the user proceeds to consume another lead from the Similar Leads screen, the rating pop-up should appear immediately after closing that screen.

In multi-account scenarios within the same app, the rating pop-up should be triggered when any single account completes 5 BuyLead consumptions.

subject: DB Insertion Failing in XMPP Message Tracking Due to Combined Message ID and Resource ID Length > 100
description_raw:
**Background:**

In our **XMPP Message Tracking Project**, we track the status of messages using a unique identifier formed by combining the **message\_id** and the **receiver\_resourceid**. This helps us uniquely identify each message instance, especially when a single message is sent to multiple recipients on the same device.

  

**Actual Behaviour:**

A Combination of the length of the message ID + the receiver resource ID is greater than 100

**Expected Behaviour:**

A combination of the length message ID + receiver resource ID, previously coming in less than 100. 

  

### Problem

Recently, the **DB team reported** that entries are **failing to insert into the XMPP message tracking table** when the `message_id` (combined string) exceeds **100 characters**.

This is impacting our message tracking accuracy, as some messages are not being logged correctly due to this length limitation.

**Combined message\_id (use in XMPP Tracking)**:  
`5209f4ff-6d25-11f0-bee8-2e039dac106d-248067903Android248067903CPH2467638b677acbba4dee9fc04bc53c63ea70`   _(Length: more than 100 characters)_

**Individual Parts**: **(Received from Android Platform)**

`message id` : `5209f4ff-6d25-11f0-bee8-2e039dac106d-248067903` → _(Length: 46)_

`receiver_resourceid`: `Android-248067903CPH2467638b677a-cbba-4dee-9fc0-4bc53c63ea70` → _(Length: 63)_

  

  

### Request for Analysis

1.  Why is the combined message ID been exceeding 100 characters recently? Is there any change in the logic or generation of the resourceid or message\_id?
2.  What is the maximum possible length of the message id? What is the logic used to generate this ID?
3.  What is the maximum possible length of the receiver resourceid? What is the format or logic behind this ID?

subject: Wrong parameters passed in URL for Free Seller BuyLead Notification Click
description_raw:

3.  go to Kibana : [https://imkibanaindia.intermesh.net/app/r/s/76L4d](https://imkibanaindia.intermesh.net/app/r/s/76L4d) and check the status of Parameters

subject: User is unable to send large media files (>20 MB, PDFs/Docs) as attachments on the LMS Conversation screen, even on a 5G network.

The PDF should be uploaded successfully within a reasonable time based on the file size and network speed.  
For example, at **4 Mbps** (~0.5 MB/s upload speed):

25 MB file → should complete in ~50 seconds

100 MB file → should complete in ~3 minutes 20 seconds

subject: Mismatch in GA trackings and DB numbers for click on Free Seller BuyLead Notification on Android
description_raw: ### **Actual Behavior** It was observed that Free Seller Notification clicks registered in GA now vastly outnumbers the clicks registered on DB( iil\_Notification table ). Issue in detail :  For notification report , we take data of **Total clicks** from Database ( fact\_iil\_notiifcation table) and then we take clicks on individual CTAs(**View Lead + Contact Buyer Now**) from GA. It was observed that generally sum of clicks on Individual CTAs were combined almost similar or ~5% higher than Total Clicks registered in iil\_notification table. But in the recent weeks , it has increased drastically and now , GA clicks are almost 100% higher than DB clicks. .  And this increase has coincided with the movement of BL Listing page to Webview.  Also, pls note that in the same time interval, the ratio have remained almost constant at unique user level. ### **Expected Behavior** Correct number should be communicated in Google Ananlytics(GA trackings should be fired only when intended event takes place) ### **Steps to reproduce:** Click on Notification CTAs and check for GA trackings placed against them.  ### **Test Environment**: 1. **Device:** Mobile 2. **Environment**: Production 3. **Operating System:** Android ###

subject: Drop in Rating Pop-up Impressions on BL Listing Screen

**Actual Behaviour**

*   Any changes made to the pop-up logic in the past few months should be identified and validated.

subject: Increase in BG Sync transactions
description_raw:
**Actual Behaviour**

*   Transactions attributed to BG Sync Notifications have shown a sharp Week-over-Week increase.
*   Previously, the weekly transaction count through BG Sync was consistently in the range of 35–40k.
*   Currently, this number has unexpectedly doubled to 70–75k.
*   No change has been made to the BG Sync transaction logic in the past few weeks.
*   This suggests a possible attribution error in tracking for BG Sync transactions.

**Expected Behaviour**

*   Transactions through BG Sync should remain in the historical range of 35–40k weekly
*   Attribution logic should correctly track transactions to the right source without inflating BG Sync numbers.
*   Cases where transactions are being wrongly attributed to BG Sync need to be identified and rectified.

subject: Prevent Deleted Cities from Being Mapped to Users (Data Loss Risk)
description_raw: #### **BUSINESS PROBLEM** ##### DA's Reference Thread: _City Data Discrepancy: Duplicate & Deleted City IDs in User Profiles_ Deleted Cities are being Mapped to users. We have identified this bug in the below 52 processes: Corrected ~7.5 lakh user records initially. ~10.9K remaining cases were found to be coming from other processes and have now been cleared. #### **BUSINESS REQUIREMENTS** The API-level check to prevent deleted city mapping to users is now live. If any process is performing additions, updates, or selections on cities through JSON  or hard-coded logic (instead of using the API), please ensure that the JSON or logic or Local DB is updated accordingly. However, it is strongly advisable to use the centralized API directly for such activities. This will ensure that no deleted cities get mapped to any users via any process. Please check and correct if any such json or hard checks are implemented currently and kindly confirm. subject: Reauthenticate API : Incorrect im_iss Cookie Format in modId: andweb
description_raw: It has been observed that requests to the **Reauthenticate API** under **modId: andweb** are sending the `im_iss` field in an incorrect format: **Expected format:** `["t": ]` **Observed format:** `[value = ""]` (key `t` missing) This incorrect format is causing the fields to **overflow the limit of keys**, which prevents the creation of additional keys and affects API processing. This ticket is **linked to the Bug Correction ticket** for `im_iss` cookie handling. Once the linked ticket is resolved, invalid `im_iss` cookies will be properly logged, allowing the system to handle these cases correctly. **Action requested:** Please prioritize fixing this bug as early as possible to prevent further key overflow and ensure consistent handling of `im_iss` cookie in logs. Screenshot for reference:   Kibana logs for reference: [https://imkibanaindia.intermesh.net/app/r/s/eQLJP](https://imkibanaindia.intermesh.net/app/r/s/eQLJP)

subject: 🔐 Security Risk: Sensitive Keys Exposed in APK (Truecaller Partner Key & TURN Server Credentials)
description_raw:
Currently, sensitive credentials such as:

**Truecaller Partner Key** — stored directly in the `AndroidManifest.xml` file.

**TURN Server credentials** — hardcoded directly in the Android application.

These credentials can be **easily extracted by decoding the APK**, which poses a potential **security and misuse risk**. Anyone with access to the APK can retrieve and use these keys outside of our control.

**Impact:**

Unauthorized usage of the Partner Key may lead to misuse of our Truecaller integration.

TURN credentials can be abused, leading to increased server costs, denial-of-service risk, or compromise of communication security.

subject: Notification Limit Remote Config Value Mismatch Causing Drop in Buylead Notification Delivery
description_raw:
**Description:**  
Notifications are not being sent when `notif_count > notif_limit`. The `notif_limit` is fetched from Remote Config (set to **30**), but locally defaults to **10** when the Remote Config fetch fails.

This results in **5K–6K notifications not sent daily** to **3K–4K users**, even though users never receive more than **13 notifications/day**.

**Steps to Reproduce:**

Remote Config fetch fails.

Local fallback limit (`notif_limit = 10`) is applied.

Users receiving more than 10 notifications are skipped.

**Expected Behavior:**  
Notification limit should remain **30**, consistent with Remote Config, ensuring all eligible notifications are sent.

**Proposed Fix:**  
Update local fallback `notif_limit` from **10 → 30**.

**Impact:**

5K–6K notifications skipped daily

3K–4K users affected

subject: Error 153 is seen when you tube videos are added in the Add video or update video journey.
description_raw:
### **Actual Behavior**

Error 153 is seen when YouTube videos are added in the Add Video or update video journey.  
Video player configuration error is seen   
This error prevents the video from being successfully added or updated, blocking users from attaching video content to their profiles or listings.

### **Expected Behavior**

No error code should appear unless the link is invalid or unsupported — and if so, a **clear, meaningful message** should be shown.  
The system should **accept valid YouTube video links**, process them correctly, and allow the user to add or update the video without errors.

### **Steps to reproduce:**

1.  Log in from the seller
2.  Now move to my product 
3.  Navigate to the **Add Video** or **Update Video** section of the My product
4.  Now paste the you tube link 
5.  Click on the play button 
6.  Observe that **Error 153** appears instead of completing the action.
7.  Now save the video, video is being added in the journey
8.  Now open the product edit page
9.  Check if video added is seen or not
10.  It is seen in the add video widget, try to play the video
11.  Configuration error is seen

### **Test Environment**:

1.  **Device:** Iphone 13
2.  **Environment**: Stage
3.  **Operating System:** IOS 18.6

subject: Search history not syncing between this webapp version and desktop. Case 2: Mobile (this build) → Desktop

Desktop

Other mobiles

This mobile build

**Actual:** Desktop searches do **not** appear in mobile history.

1.  On **Mobile (this build)**, search for some items (e.g., “GI pipe”, “LED panel light”).
2.  Confirm they appear (if at all) in **Search History** on this build.
3.  Now open **Desktop**, same account.
4.  Go to **Search → Search History**.

**Actual:** Searches done on this build **do not appear** in Desktop history.

### **Test Environment**:

1.  **Device:** Redmi note 9 pro max
2.  **Environment**: Stage
3.  **Operating System:** Android 12

subject: Fix Incorrect Notify ID & Tracking Mismatch for BG Sync Events
description_raw:
### BUSINESS OBJECTIVE

To ensure accurate tracking and reporting of BG Sync events by associating the correct notify ID and maintaining consistency between MoEngage tracking data and the iil\_notification table.

### BUSINESS REQUIREMENTS

*   Validate and correct the notify ID being sent for all BG Sync events.
*   Ensure that BG Sync events do not use outdated or incorrect notify IDs.
*   Align the tracking numbers between MoEngage and the iil\_notification table so they match for BG Sync events.
*   Ensure existing BG Sync functionality and notification workflows remain unaffected after the fix.

### ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA

*   BG Sync events must always receive and store the **correct and updated notify ID**.
*   Tracking values recorded in **MoEngage** and the **iil\_notification table** must match for BG Sync event.
*   No discrepancies should appear in the database after the fix is deployed.
*   Existing BG Sync logic, notification triggers, and downstream workflows must continue to function without any regression.
*   Existing BG Sync notification UI should be maintained

### EXPECTED IMPACT

*   Accurate tracking and reporting for all BG Sync events.
*   Elimination of incorrect notify ID usage in BG Sync records.
*   Consistent and reliable data across MoEngage and internal notification tables.

subject: iOS App – KYC Blocker Can Be Closed Allowing Access to Seller Tools & Buyleads
description_raw:
**Issue Description:**  
The KYC blocker is not strict on the iOS app. Even with unverified GST, users are able to close the blocker and:

*   Navigate to Buyleads
*   Purchase BLs
*   View buyer contact details
*   Use seller tools

**Expected Behavior:**  
Blocker must NOT be removable if **any** KYC detail remains unverified:

Mobile, Email, GST

**Actual Behavior:**  
Blocker appears but can be closed, allowing full access.

**Steps to Reproduce:**

*   Login with unverified GST user.
*   KYC blocker appears.
*   Close blocker.
*   User can purchase Buyleads and access restricted sections.

**Impact:**

*   Violation of KYC verification flow.
*   Risk of exposing buyer data to unverified sellers.
*   Compliance and security lapse.

**Request:**  
Enforce strict, non-dismissible KYC blocker on the iOS app.

subject: Unable to send video files longer than 25 seconds from LMS Conversation Screen
description_raw:
### **Actual Behavior**

The user is **unable to send** video files longer than 25 seconds, even though the video duration is **within the allowed 3-minute limit**.

Tested on a 5 Mbps upload speed and waited for more than 1.5 minutes, but the video still did not send.

### **Expected Behavior**

Users should be able to send any video **up to the 3-minute allowed limit** without errors.

If the video exceeds the 3-minute limit or the maximum file size, the app should show a **clear, user-friendly error message** explaining the restriction.

**Ideal Scenario:**

The app should automatically **compress videos** longer than 25 seconds to an optimal size/bitrate, ensuring smooth uploading and sending (similar to WhatsApp).

The video should upload successfully and appear in the conversation without failing.

No silent failures, freezes, or blocks should occur when the video is within the allowed limits.

### **Steps to reproduce:**

1.  Login as paid seller
2.  Open LMS conversation screen
3.  Send video having size more than 30 sec
4.  Check video is not being sent even on 5g network
5.  On same network user is able to send 20 mb and more size pdf file.

### **Test Environment**:

1.  **Device:** Realme 10 pro plus
2.  **Environment**: Stage
3.  **Operating System: Android 15**

subject: Android App | New Foreign Buyer Unable to Post Requirement
description_raw: Dear Team, We would like to highlight a critical issue observed in the journey of foreign buyers on the IndiaMART Android application while posting a requirement after login through email. Below are the detailed observations: ### Issue Identified Foreign buyers who register on the IndiaMART Android app using only their email ID (without adding name, mobile number, or other profile details) are facing a blockage while trying to post their requirement after login.  ### Journey A buyer signs up on the Android app using only their email ID. The buyer does not complete profile details such as name, contact number, or pincode. After login, the buyer clicks on Post Requirement. A pop-up appears asking the buyer to enter their name. The buyer enters the name and clicks Submit. Instead of proceeding to the next step, the app displays an error message: “Please enter valid Pincode.” Buyer is stuck here and is not able to post his requirement.​ ​ ​ ### ​Impact New foreign buyers are unable to post their requirements and leading to a poor first-time user experience Loss of potential buyleads ### Expected Solution  ### Once the buyer enters their name, the app should allow seamless continuation of the requirement posting journey

subject: Back navigation flickers to Homepage before returning to Photo Search Results
description_raw:
### **Actual Behavior**

User uploads a photo from gallery.

User lands on **Photo Search Results** → then opens a product **PDP Page**.

User taps **Back** → correctly returns to **Photo Search Results**.

User taps **Back** again →

App **briefly navigates to the Homepage for ~1 second**,

Then **automatically jumps back** to the **Photo Search Results** page again.

This creates a flickering/jumping experience.

### **Expected Behavior**

On pressing **Back** from PDP → return to **Photo Search Results**.

On pressing **Back** again → go directly to the **Homepage** without flicker or auto-redirect.

No unintended navigation or page flashing should occur.

### **Steps to reproduce:**

1.  Login to app with 1161161167
2.  Click on Image icon and
3.  upload image - [https://ibb.co/BVT4hhxW](https://ibb.co/BVT4hhxW)
4.  then  go to PDP page

subject: Duplicate offer displayed on Recent screen
description_raw:
**Actual Behaviour:**  
When the user lands on the Relevant screen via a notification, the offer ID is passed to the display service, which correctly places that offer in the first position.  
However, when the user navigates from the Relevant screen to the Recent screen, the offer ID is still being passed to the display service. Since this scenario may not be handled at the service end, the same offer is returned again and displayed twice.

**Expected Behaviour:**  
The offer ID should only be passed to the display service when landing on the Relevant screen via a notification.   
For subsequent screen navigations, such as moving to the Recent screen, the offer ID should not be passed, and the service should return a non-duplicated list of offers.

subject: Security Concern in Foreign Mobile Number Update Flow
description_raw: **Issue Identified:** A critical issue has been identified in the Android app, where a user can edit and update the mobile number in their profile without any OTP verification, validation, or ownership check. This means a user can add any random or incorrect mobile number to their IndiaMART account, without any authentication causing a risk of identity spoofing or misrepresentation.  **Current Flow:** Currently, the Android flow allows a user to: * Enter any mobile number * Save it instantly, without any trigger, an OTP, and without confirming whether the number actually belongs to the user **Journey:** Testing Details: **GLID:** 234536198 **Country:** USA Refer below: The number was updated in GLID as well, refer to the screenshots below.

subject: Rating submission behavior is incorrect in Rating Feedback popup
description_raw:
**Description:**

**Expected Behavior:**

The rating should be submitted **with or without** entering text in the feedback box.

The rating should **not** be submitted when the user closes (crosses) the popup without explicitly submitting.

**Actual Behavior:**

Rating submission requires feedback text.

Closing the popup triggers rating submission.

subject: Resolve Crash in BuyLeadPageViewController.viewDidLayoutSubviews()
description_raw:
**Description:**

We are currently experiencing a crash in the BuyLeadPageViewController.viewDidLayoutSubviews() method, triggered by an NSGenericException. The error message suggests that there's an issue activating a constraint with no common ancestor.

**Steps to Reproduce:**

1.  The crash occurs on the user's device during the layout subviews process of the BuyLeadPageViewController.
2.  It's likely triggered by a constraint issue, as indicated by the error message.

**Expected Behavior:**

The app should not crash, and the layout subviews process should complete successfully.

**Actual Behavior:**

The app crashes with the following error message:

```text
NSGenericException - Unable to activate constraint with anchors <NSLayoutYAxisAnchor:...> and <NSLayoutYAxisAnchor:...> because they have no common ancestor.  Does the constraint or its anchors reference i...
```

**Additional Information:**

*   **Crash Count:** 1,100+ in the last 90 days
*   **Affected Versions:** 13.4.4 to 13.5.6
*   **Affected Devices:** iOS 16 (28%), iPadOS 18 (0%)

*   Happens when the video is **playing**

*   Observe thumbnails at the bottom can still be selected

subject: ANR on LIVE: Input dispatching timed out in PriorityThreadFactory.lambda$newThread$0
description_raw:
## **Environment**

**App Package:** `com.indiamart.m`

**Module:** `com.indiamart.shared.PriorityThreadFactory`

**Release Stage:** Production

**Time Range:** Last 28 days

## **Impact**

**Affected Users:** 454

**ANR Events:** 475

**User-perceived:** Yes

**Trend:**

Users ↑ **2.48%** vs previous 28 days

Events ↑ **3.04%** vs previous 28 days

## **Issue Summary**

The app is triggering an **ANR due to input dispatch timeout**, indicating that the **main thread is blocked** for too long while handling user input.

The stack trace shows heavy background activity and thread contention originating from threads created via:

com.indiamart.shared.PriorityThreadFactory.lambda$newThread$0  
  

## **Observations from Thread Dump**

Large number of active background threads:

OkHttp (multiple hosts)

Firebase (Remote Config, Messaging, Crashlytics)

Smack (XMPP)

WebView / Chromium threads

Multiple threads created via **PriorityThreadFactory**

High thread contention and thread pool saturation

Main/UI thread likely blocked waiting for:

Network responses

Synchronous waits

Locks / thread pool availability

## **Suspected Root Causes**

**Blocking work indirectly affecting Main Thread**

Heavy network I/O and parsing

Synchronous waits on shared executors

**Unbounded or poorly managed thread creation**

PriorityThreadFactory creating too many threads

**Thread pool starvation**

Tasks queued but not executed promptly

**Main thread waiting on background results**

Possible `.get()`, `wait()`, `join()`, or synchronous callbacks

**High concurrent OkHttp / Smack / Firebase operations**

## **Steps to Reproduce**

_Not consistently reproducible locally_  
Observed in production under real-user load and network activity.

subject: ANR: Input dispatching timed out due to thread pool saturation || android.os.MessageQueue.nativePollOnce
description_raw:
## **Environment**

**App Package:** `com.indiamart.m`

**Issue Type:** ANR – Input dispatching timed out

**Native Method:** `android.os.MessageQueue.nativePollOnce`

**Release Stage:** Production

**Time Window:** Last 28 days

## **Impact**

**Affected Users:** 374 (**↑ 4.47%** vs previous period)

**ANR Events:** 440 (**↑ 9.18%** vs previous period)

**User-perceived:** Yes

  

## **Issue Summary**

The app is experiencing **Input Dispatch ANRs** where the **main thread is blocked**, preventing UI events from being processed within the system timeout window.

Although the main thread appears idle in `nativePollOnce`, the thread dump shows **extreme background thread contention and saturation**, particularly involving:

*   `PriorityThreadFactory`
*   Heavy SQLite write/delete operations
*   Multiple unbounded thread pools
*   SDK background work (MoEngage, Firebase, Ads, WebView, OkHttp)

This results in **resource starvation**, indirectly blocking the UI thread.

  

### **Thread Pool Explosion**

Hundreds of active threads:

*   Firebase (Crashlytics, Messaging, Sessions)
*   MoEngage
*   Ads SDKs
*   WebView / Chromium
*   OkHttp

Many threads waiting → indicates **pool starvation + oversubscription**

  

### **Thread Pool Explosion**

Hundreds of active threads:

Firebase (Crashlytics, Messaging, Sessions)

MoEngage

Ads SDKs

WebView / Chromium

OkHttp

Many threads waiting → indicates **pool starvation + oversubscription**

subject: Context Menu is not loading correctly in BL page
description_raw:
### **Description**

*   On the **BL (Buyleads) page**, the **Context Menu** does not load completely on **iOS devices**.
*   The top menu options such as **Search Buyleads**, **Shortlisted Buyleads**, **Hidden Leads**, **Latest Tenders**, etc., are either missing or partially visible when the context menu is opened after scrolling the page.

### **Actual Behavior**

*   When the user scrolls the BL page and then taps on the **Context Menu**:
    *   **Search Buyleads** option is not visible.
    *   **Shortlisted Buyleads** appears only half visible.
*   On manually scrolling downwards **inside the context menu**, all options become visible.
*   This issue occurs very **frequently**

### **Expected Behavior**

*   When the **Context Menu** is tapped, **all menu options** (Search Buyleads, Shortlisted Buyleads, Hidden Leads, Latest Tenders, etc.) should be:
    *   Fully visible
    *   Properly aligned
    *   Accessible immediately without requiring additional scrolling.

### **Steps to reproduce:**

*   Open the **BL (Buyleads) page** on an **iOS device**.
*   Scroll down the BL page.
*   Tap on the **Context Menu**.
*   Observe that:
    *   The menu does not load fully.
    *   Top menu options are either missing or partially visible.

### **Test Environment**:

1.  **Device:** Mobile
2.  **Operating System:** iOS

subject: IM Insta seller is able to send messages via the Saved Reply screen, PDF quotation, Mini Catalog, and Post-Call popup even when the chatbox is locked.
description_raw:
### **Actual Behavior**

IM Insta seller is able to send messages via the Saved Reply screen, PDF quotation, Mini Catalog, and Post-Call popup even when the chatbox is locked.

Seller is also able to ask for review via suggestive template/post call popup, share catalog link from mini catalog screen, Rate the buyer

When user send any type of messages from mentioned journeys chatbox gets unlocked and user can send any type message without any restriction.

Due to the above issue, the chatbox gets unlocked and remains unlocked until the buyer sends a new enquiry.

### **Expected Behavior**

User should not be able Perform following activity if the chatbox is locked :  
Click on text box.  
click on attachment icon    
send ask for review message from post call popup and suggestive templates.  
send pdf quotation   
Rate the buyer   
send catalog link from mini catalog   
send message from saved reply

share catalog link from mini catalog screen.

for freezing chatbox, the text reply will be locked till buyer replies, either through bmc or through whatsapp.

It will be unlocked only if buyer reply after connection is made or outbound template condition is not satisfied ( No exchange of message within 7 days)

### **Steps to reproduce:**

1.  Login as paid seller
2.  Open conversation of any user where outboudn template condifiotn is satisfied.
3.  Send message from saved reply or post call popup after outbound template is sent.
4.  check the chatbox gets unlocked.
5.  User can send send all type of messages even before buyers reply.

### **Test Environment**:

1.  **Device:** Realme 10 pro plus
2.  **Environment**: Stage
3.  **Operating System: Android 15**

subject: Crash on App Launch due to ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException while fetching AppSet ID from Google Play Services
description_raw:
## **Actual Behavior**

On app launch (cold start), the application crashes immediately.  
The crash occurs during `Application.onCreate()` while fetching the **Google AppSet ID**, resulting in an `ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException` originating from Google Play Services internal code.

## **Expected Behavior**

The application should launch successfully without crashing.  
Fetching the AppSet ID should be treated as a **non-blocking, best-effort operation**, and any failure in Google Play Services should not impact app startup.

## **Steps to Reproduce**

Install the app on an Android device

Ensure Google Play Services is present (auto-updated or partially initialized state)

Perform a **cold start** of the app

App crashes immediately during launch on affected devices

> **Note:** Issue is non-deterministic and reproducible only on a subset of devices due to Google Play Services internal state.

## **Logs**

Yes, [crash](https://console.firebase.google.com/project/artful-affinity-634/crashlytics/app/android:com.indiamart.m/issues/bf6610235a96627ccbab77c1c6d1fdb0?time=7d&types=crash&versions=13.6.9_07JAN26%20(718)&sessionEventKey=69651B57011F000136735A50E0D6048D_2172952012536686008) observed in production logs (Crashlytics).

## **Bug Type**

Functional / Logical (Startup crash – third-party dependency handling)

## **Bug Source**

Launch / Production Monitoring (Crashlytics)

subject: Screen Sharing displays User’s outside-app activity when app is in background before connection is established.

subject: Improve OTP verification flow by better error handling
description_raw:
When a user enters an incorrect OTP, the system displays an error message (**"Invalid OTP! Please enter correct OTP."**), but the input field is not cleared. Consequently, users often tap "Submit" again without realizing they are resubmitting the same invalid value, leading to multiple consecutive failures.

**Observed Issues:**

*   The OTP field is not cleared after an incorrect submission.
*   There is no inline error message near the input field.
*   The "Submit" button remains enabled after an invalid entry.
*   The cursor/focus is not reset to the field after an error.
*   There is no prompt to resend the OTP after multiple failures and until the timer went to 0.

**Suggested Implementation:**

*   Clear OTP field after an incorrect OTP submission
*   Do not enable Submit button until 4 digits are typed in OTP textfield.
*   Make OTP textfield active after an unsuccessful attempt

Reference mail sub: Re: Case Study : Repeated OTP Failures Due to OTP Field Not Reset After Error on iOS APP

subject: Applied filters not displayed in More Filters screen when reopened, causing UI state inconsistency
description_raw:
### **Actual Behavior**

When user applies filters (Source, Date, Label, Category, WhatsApp) from More Filters screen and then reopens the More Filters screen, the previously selected filter values are not shown/pre-selected in the More Filters UI, even though the filters are still actively applied to the LMS Listings screen.

Also replicates when user apply any upfront filter which is present in both screen and opens more filter screen.

### **Expected Behavior**

When user reopens More Filters screen, all previously applied filter selections should be displayed/pre-selected in their respective fields, reflecting the current active filter state in LMS Listings.

### **Steps to reproduce:**

**Scenario 1: Source/Date/Label Filters**

1.  Login as paid seller
2.  Navigate to LMS Listings screen
3.  Click on "More Filters" icon
4.  Select Source filter (e.g., "Buylead")
5.  Select Date range (e.g., "Previous month")
6.  Select Label (e.g., "Irrevalant")
7.  Click "Apply Filters" button
8.  **Observe:** Filters are applied correctly, listings are filtered
9.  Click on "More Filters" icon again to reopen
10.  **Observe:** Source, Date, and Label selections are cleared/reset in the UI
11.  Press device back button
12.  **Observe:** Filters are still applied to listings (inconsistent with More Filters UI state)

**Scenario 2: Category/WhatsApp Filters**

1.  Login as paid seller
2.  Navigate to LMS Listings screen
3.  Click on "More Filters" icon
4.  Select Category filter (e.g., "T shirt")
5.  Select WhatsApp filter (e.g., "WhatsApp Orders Only")
6.  Click "Apply Filters" button
7.  **Observe:** Filters are applied correctly
8.  Reopen "More Filters" screen
9.  **Observe:** Category and WhatsApp filter selections are not shown as selected

**Affected Filters:**

*   All Filters.

**Impact:** Users cannot see which filters are currently active when reopening More Filters screen, leading to:

*   Confusion about current filter state
*   Risk of accidentally removing filters by applying "new" filters
*   Poor user experience due to UI-data inconsistency
*   Need to navigate back to listings to verify active filters

**Workaround:** User must remember which filters were applied or check the listings screen to see active filters.

### **Test Environment**:

1.  **Device:** Realme 10 pro plus
2.  **Environment**: Stage
3.  **Operating System: Android 15**

### **Actual Behavior**

When user attempts to select multiple Source filter options (Enquiry, Buy Lead, Calls) in the More Filters screen, only one source can be selected at a time. Selecting a new source automatically deselects the previously selected source (radio button behavior instead of checkbox behavior).

### **Expected Behavior**

Users should be able to select multiple Source filter options simultaneously (Enquiry, Buy Lead, Calls) using checkboxes, allowing them to view listings from multiple sources in a single filtered view.

### **Steps to reproduce:**

*   Login as paid seller
*   Navigate to LMS Listings screen
*   Click on "More Filters" icon
*   Navigate to "Source" filter section
*   Select "Enquiry" option
*   **Observe:** "Enquiry" is selected (highlighted/checked)
*   Now select "Buy Lead" option
*   **Observe:** "Buy Lead" is selected BUT "Enquiry" is automatically deselected
*   Attempt to select "Calls" while "Buy Lead" is selected
*   **Observe:** Only "Calls" remains selected, "Buy Lead" is deselected

### **Test Environment**

1.  **Device:** Realme 10 pro plus
2.  **Environment**: Stage
3.  **Operating System:** Android 15

subject: Suggestive templates incorrectly shown on post purchase Buy Lead popup when outbound template already sent to same buyer
description_raw:
### **Actual Behavior**

When a seller has already sent an **outbound template** to a buyer and then purchases another Buy Lead for the **same buyer** from the BL listing screen, the **post purchase Buy Lead popup still displays suggestive templates**. Since the outbound template can only be sent once per day and a connection between the buyer and seller already exists, displaying suggestive templates in this scenario is incorrect behavior.

### **Expected Behavior**

When the seller has already sent an outbound template to the same buyer, the post purchase Buy Lead popup should:

1.  **Not display suggestive templates**
2.  Show only **"Call Now"** and **"View Details"** CTAs
3.  Display an **informational message** such as _"Message already sent"_ to inform the seller that an outbound template has already been sent to this buyer today

### **Steps to reproduce:**

*   Login as a seller
*   Open the conversation of buyer send outbound template
*   Navigate back to the **BL listing screen**
*   Search for the **same buyer's Buy Lead** and purchase it 
*   Observe the **post purchase Buy Lead popup**
*   Observe — suggestive templates are still displayed even though outbound template was already sent today 

### **Test Environment**:

1.  **Device:** Realme 10 pro plus
2.  **Environment**: Stage
3.  **Operating System: Android 15**

subject: Notification permission banner does not update immediately after permission change from app settings
description_raw:
### **Actual Behavior**

The **Notification Permission banner** on the BL page does not update correctly based on **real-time permission** changes made from the device’s app settings.

Two issues are observed:

1.  When the user clicks on “Turn on notification” from the banner and enables notification permission in app settings, then returns to the app, the banner is still visible. The user must navigate to another page or kill and relaunch the app for the banner to disappear.
2.  When the user disables notification permission from app settings and returns to the app, the banner does not appear immediately. The user has to relaunch the app for the banner to become visible.

This indicates that permission state is not being refreshed dynamically when the app resumes.

Tested account- **1435463454 (issue replicating for mentioned account)**

### **Expected Behavior**

*   Banner should disappear immediately after enabling notification permission.
*   Banner should appear immediately after disabling notification permission.
*   No need to relaunch or navigate to another page.

### **Steps to reproduce:**

#### Scenario 1 – Enabling Permission

1.  Disable notification permission from device settings.
2.  Open the app and navigate to the BL page.
3.  Click on “Turn on notification” in the banner.
4.  Enable notification permission in app settings.
5.  Return to the app.

#### Scenario 2 – Disabling Permission

1.  Enable notification permission.
2.  Disable notification permission from device settings.
3.  Return to the app without killing it.

### **Test Environment**:

1.  **Device:** iphone13
2.  **Environment**: Stage
3.  **Operating System:** ios 26.2.1

subject: Post Call Popup – Incorrect Buyer Name Displayed & "Ask for Review" Template Shown Incorrectly
description_raw:
### **Actual Behavior**

Two UI issues are observed on the post-call popup that appears after a seller clicks the "Call Now" CTA on a purchased buy lead.

Issue 1 – Incorrect Buyer Name in Header: The popup header displays "New Buyer" instead of the actual buyer's name. The buyer name (e.g., Suresh Sharma) is visible on the buy lead detail screen but is not being passed correctly to the post-call popup header.

Issue 2 – "Ask for Review" Template Shown Incorrectly: The "Ask for Review" quick reply template is being displayed as an option inside the post-call popup under the YES section. This template should only appear on the LMS conversation screen and only after certain conditions are satisfied. It should not be visible on the post-call popup at all.

Replicating for both IM & Non Insta seller

### **Expected Behavior**

*   The popup header should display the actual buyer's name fetched from the buy lead details.
*   The "Ask for Review" template should not appear in the post-call popup. It should only be shown on the LMS conversation screen after the required conditions are met

### **Steps to reproduce:**

*   Login as a paid seller on the app.
*   Navigate to the Buy Lead listing screen.
*   Purchase any buy lead.
*   Open the buy lead detail screen.
*   Click on the "Call Now" CTA.
*   Observe the post-call popup that appears after the call.

### **Test Environment**:

1.  **Device:** Realme 10 pro plus
2.  **Environment**: Stage
3.  **Operating System: Android 15**

subject: Post Call Popup – Clicking on Quick Reply Templates Does Not Send Message
description_raw:
### **Actual Behavior**

On the post-call popup that appears after clicking the "Call Now" CTA on a purchased buy lead, the quick reply templates under YES and NO sections are non-functional. When a seller taps on any template option such as "Thanks for talking to me", "Ask for Review", or "I tried to call you but could not connect", no message is sent to the buyer and there is no visible response or feedback to the action.

*   Tapping on any template in the post-call popup does nothing.
*   No message is sent to the buyer.
*   The popup remains as-is with no state change or confirmation

Replicating for both IM and Non Insta sellers.

Note : For IM Insta seller outbound template post call popup is not shown . ( It is raised in 13.7.2\_t1 cycle)

### **Expected Behavior**

*   On tapping a template, the respective message should be sent to the buyer immediately.
*   After the message is sent successfully, all other remaining template options on the popup should be hidden, leaving only the view details cta visible.
*   A success indication or the popup should dismiss confirming the message was delivered.

### **Steps to reproduce:**

*   Login as a paid seller on the app.
*   Navigate to the Buy Lead listing screen.
*   Purchase any buy lead.
*   Open the buy lead detail screen.
*   Click on the "Call Now" CTA.
*   Wait for the post-call popup to appear.
*   Tap on any template option under YES or NO section such as "Thanks for talking to me" or "I tried to call you but could not connect".

### **Test Environment**:

1.  **Device:** Realme 10 pro plus
2.  **Environment**: Stage
3.  **Operating System:** Android 15

subject: Wait for Buyer Reply" System Message Not Updating to "Buyer Read Your Message" in Real Time or on Conversation Reopen After Outbound Template is Sent
description_raw:
### **Actual Behavior**

*   The "Wait for Buyer Reply" system message does not update to "Buyer Read Your Message" in real time after the buyer reads the message on WhatsApp.
*   Closing and reopening the conversation also does not refresh or update the status.
*   The status only changes after the buyer sends a reply message from WhatsApp, not on message read

### **Expected Behavior**

*   Once the buyer reads the outbound template message on WhatsApp, the system-generated "Wait for Buyer Reply" message should update to "Buyer Read Your Message" in real time without any additional action from the seller.
*   If not updated in real time, the status must at minimum reflect the correct read state when the seller closes and reopens the conversation.
*   The update should not be dependent on the buyer sending a reply message.

### **Steps to reproduce:**

*   Login as an IM Insta seller on the app.
*   Send an enquiry to the above seller 
*   An autoresponder message will be sent to the buyer automatically.
*   Open the conversation of the buyer from the seller's LMS conversation screen.
*   From the buyer's account, open WhatsApp and read the message sent by the seller (do not reply).
*   Switch back to the seller's app and observe the "Wait for Buyer Reply" system message status in the conversation.
*   Also close the conversation and reopen it to check if the status updates on reopen.

### **Test Environment:**

1.  **Device:** Realme 10 pro plus
2.  **Environment**: Stage
3.  **Operating System:** Android 15

subject: Crash Fixes - Subscription, Tap Enquiry, MyProfile, BMC Webview
description_raw:
### **Actual Behavior**

Crash List -  
1\. [Crash Link](https://console.firebase.google.com/project/artful-affinity-634/crashlytics/app/android:com.indiamart.m/issues/071ef455113cffd59d7d3d64b8b3c0e0?time=7d&types=crash&versions=13.7.2_22FEB26%20(725))   
 **Screen: Subscription Plan** - Both paid seller and free seller - including the native journey from BL   
 RCA: PayActivity.initView() called mToolbar.setTitle() in onCreate. After the ViewStub deferral change, mToolbar is null for Buyer users until post-first-frame — initView() runs before that.  
 Fix: Call inflateTopChromeIfNeeded() at top of initView() to force synchronous inflation; added if (mToolbar != null) guard on setTitle() as safety net.  
 Must verify: Naviagtion to Sub Plan screen all scenarios must be covered, **Subscription Plan title** should be displayed correctly

\---

2\. [Crash Link](https://console.firebase.google.com/project/artful-affinity-634/crashlytics/app/android:com.indiamart.m/issues/37fdb9f2ea6b5125ede9f37febf41b74?time=7d&types=crash&versions=13.7.2_22FEB26%20(725)&sessionEventKey=699B6FEF03C200017866765AF1C274A2_2188244676645329473)  
 **Screen: 2 Tap Enquiry screen**

Steps to reproduce: Trigger 2 tap flow   
 RCA: getBundle() called finish() + return when isqBundle == null, but init() continued executing sendGA(), addEnrichmentData(), and submitISQs() — all of which dereference isqBundle directly.  
 Fix: Added if (isqBundle == null) return in init() after getBundle(); added if (isqBundle == null) return at top of addEnrichmentData(); added isqBundle != null && guard in submitISQs() before isqBundle.getString().  
 Must verify: All touchpoints to this screen to be covered, cover recent story devlopment if any (not related to app startup optimization)

\---

3\. [Crash Link](https://console.firebase.google.com/project/artful-affinity-634/crashlytics/app/android:com.indiamart.m/issues/19dcc1293bfed642a24edb8ecf01dbd5?time=7d&types=crash&versions=13.7.2_22FEB26%20(725)&sessionEventKey=699BC869001B000137B853A1CEDE9157_2188341954522514425)   
**Screen: MyProfile** (Buyer and Seller both)

Steps to reproduce: Login as Buyer/Seller → navigate to My Profile  
 RCA: MyProfile.onStart() called toolbar.setTitle() unconditionally. toolbar is assigned in BaseFragment.onCreateBaseSupport() via getToolBar() which returns null for Buyer users before first-frame post fires.  
 Fix: Added re-fetch of toolbar reference in onStart() if null, followed by null guard before setTitle(); fixed chained activityMessangerInterface.getToolBar().setVisibility() in onCreateOptionsMenu().  
 Must verify: Naviagtion to profile screen and title display shold work fine

\---

4\. No crash here - still needs verification (Safe checks applied)  
 **Screen: BMC WebView screen**

Steps to reproduce: Login as Buyer → open Messages screen  
 RCA: onCreateOptionsMenu() called toolbar.setVisibility() and toolbar.setTitle() inside isNativeHeaderVisible block with no null guard on toolbar.  
 Fix: Wrapped both calls in if (toolbar != null) block.  
 Must verify: Open BMC , landing should be okay and header should be properly displayed

\---  
 Common root cause across all crashes: BaseActivity ViewStub deferral change — mToolbar is null for Buyer users (buyerCentered=true, not paid supplier) until after the first frame renders. Any code in early lifecycle  
 (onCreate/onStart/onCreateOptionsMenu) that accesses mToolbar or the inherited BaseFragment.toolbar field without a null check will NPE.

subject: Avoid removing all notifications on switch account and Logout cases.
description_raw:
### **Actual Behavior**

For certain actions in the app, All Delivered Notifications on Notification panel are being cleared. Due to this, user loses all delivered Notifications and if there are any valid BL notifications in panel, they are lost.

When There are multiple accounts added in switch state and Let's say 3rd account is active. When user clicks on Notification of any other account, switch account happens in app before redirection (expected) but all delivered notifications are removed in this case.

subject: PAN number text field accepts more than 10 characters — no max length validation applied
description_raw:
### **Actual Behavior**

During the SOI (Sell on IndiaMART) registration journey, the PAN number input field does not enforce a **maximum character limit of 10**. A user can type beyond 10 characters without any restriction, error message, or validation trigger. A valid PAN number follows a strict 10-character alphanumeric format _(ABCDE1234F — 5 letters + 4 digits + 1 letter)_. The absence of max length validation on this field can lead to invalid data submission and downstream data integrity issues.

### **Expected Behavior**

*   The PAN number field should **restrict input to exactly 10 characters**
*   Valid PAN format: **5 uppercase letters + 4 digits + 1 uppercase letter** _(e.g. ABCDE1234F)_
*   Once 10 characters are entered, the field should **stop accepting further input**
*   Optionally, an inline format validation message should appear if the entered value does not match the PAN format pattern

### **Steps to reproduce:**

*   Login as a **new user**
*   Tap **"Sell on IndiaMART for Free"**
*   Enter a valid **product name** and **business name**
*   On the GST screen, select **"Not Exempted"**
*   Tap on the **PAN Number text field**
*   Type more than **10 characters** (e.g. enter `ABCDE1234FXYZ` — 13 characters)
*   Observe whether the field restricts input at 10 characters

### **Test Environment**:

1.  **Device:** Realme 10 pro plus
2.  **Environment**: Stage
3.  **Operating System : Android 15**

subject: After a payment failure via UPI, when the device back button is pressed, an unexpected error popup appears on the payment page.
description_raw:
### **Actual Behavior**

When a free seller initiates a subscription purchase via the Monthly Payment Banner on the Buylead listing screen, selects UPI as the payment method, and the payment fails due to a wrong PIN, pressing the **Back CTA** after dismissing the failure toast triggers an **"Unexpected Error" popup** on the payment screen. The back navigation behavior is also broken — requiring **two back presses** to exit, landing on Premium Services screen first, then Buylead — instead of directly returning to Buylead with a payment failure message.

### **Expected Behavior**

*   After a UPI payment failure, pressing Back should either:
    *   **Option A:** Return to Payment screen → then Buylead listing on second back press, OR
    *   **Option B:** Directly navigate to **Buylead listing screen** with a **payment failure popup/toast**
*   **No "Unexpected Error" popup** should appear at any point in this back navigation flow

### **Steps to reproduce:**

*   Login with a **free seller** account
*   Open **Buylead listing screen**
*   Scroll down to at least **3 BL cards**
*   Verify the **Monthly Payment Banner** is visible
*   Tap **Buy Now** on the banner
*   On the Payment screen, select **UPI** as the payment option
*   Select a bank from the UPI app list
*   Enter an **incorrect UPI PIN** to intentionally fail the payment
*   Wait for the **payment failure toast** to appear, then tap **Dismiss**
*   On the Payment screen, tap the **Back CTA (←)**
*   Observe the screen behavior

### **Test Environment**:

1.  **Device:** Realme 10 pro plus
2.  **Environment**: Stage
3.  Operating System: Android 15

subject: LMS Listing — Previous filter results still displayed after switching Activity Date to Lead Date from upfront filter when Date filter was also applied via More Filters
description_raw:
### **Actual Behavior**

*   The Date filter chip gets removed from the UI (filter resets) — this is expected since the date context changed.
*   The Activity Date chip changes to Lead Date — this is also expected.
*   However, the listing still displays results based on the previously applied filters (Date + Activity Date). The leads do not refresh to reflect the reset.
*   The listing only corrects itself when the user manually refreshes the page.

### **Expected Behavior**

When switching from Activity Date to Lead Date on the upfront filter, if the Date filter resets and gets removed, the listing should also refresh and display leads based on the current active filters only (Lead Date without any date range), not the stale previous filter combination.

**Note:** If only Lead Date is applied from More Filters (without Date filter), the upfront filter reflects it correctly. The issue occurs specifically when a Date filter is also applied alongside Activity Date.

**Ref Ticket:** 647650

### **Steps to reproduce:**

*   Login as a paid seller
*   Open LMS listing screen
*   Open More Filter screen
*   Apply Date filter (select Month/Year) and set filter type to Activity Date
*   Apply filters and return to LMS listing screen
*   From the upfront filter on LMS listing, switch Activity Date to Lead Date

1.  **Device:** Realme 10 pro plus

subject: static IMSJSwiftSideBarController.validateForNavigationSetup() | App Crash
description_raw: ## Ticket Metadata ## Overview The app crashes on the main thread during launch while setting up the tab bar after a successful user-details network response. The crash originates inside `IMSJSwiftSideBarController.validateForNavigationSetup()` at **line 716** and is triggered by a Swift assertion failure — most likely a force-unwrap of a `nil` view controller reference. ## Exception Details ## Crash Call Chain ```text NetworkManager.jsonRequest → success closure (NetworkManager.swift:278) AccountManager.userDetails → success closure (AccountManager+IMApp.swift:167) AppDelegate.callForUserDetailService (AppDelegate.swift:861) AppDelegate.createTabBarWithNewData (AppDelegate.swift:974) AppDelegate.moveToRespectiveController (AppDelegate.swift:1357) IMSJSwiftSideBarController.hideLeftMenu (IMSJSwiftSideBarController.swift:379) IMSJSwiftSideBarController.validateForNavigationSetup ← 💥 line 716 ``` ## Root Cause * `validateForNavigationSetup()` force-unwraps a view controller (or window root) that is `nil` at execution time. * The network response for user details completes and immediately drives tab bar construction before the `UIWindow` hierarchy is fully established. * `AppDelegate` is orchestrating navigation setup directly from a network callback, making execution order unpredictable across app launch states. ## Recommended Fix * Replace the force-unwrap / bare `assert` at line 716 with a `guard`\-based nil check and a graceful `return`. * Add an `isNavigationReady()` guard in `hideLeftMenu` to bail out safely if the window hierarchy does not yet exist. * Ensure the network success closure dispatches to `DispatchQueue.main.async` before calling any navigation or UI setup. * Migrate navigation orchestration out of `AppDelegate` into a Coordinator or `SceneDelegate`, using `@MainActor` + `async/await` to sequence navigation only after the root UI is confirmed ready. * Replace deprecated `UIApplication.shared.keyWindow` with the `connectedScenes` API (required for iOS 15+).

subject: HelloTrade Deeplink issue
description_raw: ## Actual Behavior When an **unpaid customer** accesses the **Hello Trade deep link inside the Indiamart Android application**, Hello Trade opens inside the **Indiamart WebView**. However, the **deep link is not processed correctly in the WebView environment**, resulting in the expected redirection not occurring. This breaks the intended navigation flow for unpaid users. The deep link appears to not be intercepted or forwarded properly from the WebView to the Android layer. ## Expected Behavior When an unpaid customer triggers the **Hello Trade deep link within the Indiamart app**, the deep link should: Be properly intercepted by the WebView. Be forwarded to the Android layer if required. Redirect the user to the correct destination within the Hello Trade flow. The navigation flow should work consistently both **inside the Indiamart WebView and outside the app**. ## Steps to Reproduce 1. Open the **IndiaMART Android application**. 2\. Navigate to **Hello Trade**. 3\. Ensure the user is an **unpaid customer**. 4\. Hello Trade opens **inside the IndiaMART WebView**. 5\. Trigger the **Hello Trade deep link** within the page. **Result:** Deep link redirection does not work properly inside the WebView. Working Scenario [https://drive.google.com/file/d/1fCnnDRs5aWGz8Wnmpnw7elOaX7P48ol2/view?usp=drive\_link](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1fCnnDRs5aWGz8Wnmpnw7elOaX7P48ol2/view?usp=drive_link) Non-Working Scenario [https://drive.google.com/file/d/1lXCULPx94ldva3Rf0ibmf\_t\_8j-22j2D/view?usp=drive\_link](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1lXCULPx94ldva3Rf0ibmf_t_8j-22j2D/view?usp=drive_link) ## Test Environment **Device:** Mobile **Environment:** Production **Operating System:** Android **Browser/Version:** WebView inside Indiamart Android App ## Logs Currently, no browser console logs are available since the issue occurs inside the **Android WebView**. Relevant **Android logs or WebView debugging logs** may need to be reviewed by the Android team. Video recordings demonstrating **working vs non-working flows** will be attached for reference. ## User Type Indian Users (Unpaid Customers) ## Bug Type Functional / Logical ## Bug Source User Journey Testing ## Intervention Required (Android Team) The Android team should: Review how **deep links are handled inside the Indiamart WebView** when Hello Trade is loaded. Ensure the **WebView properly intercepts and forwards deep link intents to the Android layer** where necessary. Validate and fix the **unpaid customer flow**. Please review and let us know if **any configuration or changes are required from our side**. it is working fine with all users in this version.
